name: otc-desk-intro-video
description: 30-second motion-graphics intro for Private OTC Agent Desk (Remotion)

scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:webm && npm run render:square && npm run render:poster
scripts.frames: remotion render Intro out/frames/landscape --sequence --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion render IntroSquare out/frames/square --sequence --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95
scripts.encode: node scripts/encode.mjs out/frames/landscape out/intro.mp4 23 && node scripts/encode.mjs out/frames/landscape out/intro.webm 38 && node scripts/encode.mjs out/frames/square out/intro-square.mp4 23
scripts.render:safe: npm run frames && npm run encode && npm run render:poster
scripts.walkthrough:assets: npm run walkthrough:fonts && npm run walkthrough:capture && npm run walkthrough:voice && npm run walkthrough:sfx
